full_judgment: 25. Section 20 of the Ain does not automatically prove, nor authenticate the genuineness or legality of the mortgage deed or of the power of attorney relied upon by the bank. Nor section 12 of the Ain authorizes any court to draw any presumption of genuineness of such deeds and documents. All deeds and documents on which the lender will rely for getting any relief in an Artha Rin suit must be proved as per provisions of sections 67 to 71 of the Evidence Act, 1872, and the burden of proof always lies with the bank in view of the provisions of section 102 of the Evidence Act, 1872. Otherwise, the bar imposed by sub-section (8) of section 12 of the Ain shall not apply.
